data.text: Luke, thanks for keeping the total at 50—that protects next month’s fish and our village’s income. I’m willing to take 15 this month, but only if everyone agrees to their specific share before we fish. I’d be just as happy with 10 each; I don’t want my extra income coming at someone else’s expense without their consent. If we use your split, let’s agree on the rotation now so everyone gets a fair turn. Jack, how do you feel about taking 7.5 this month?
